# Muhammad Arslan

Muhammad Arslan is a Senior Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer based in Lahore, Pakistan. He builds full-stack portfolio and product work with React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, REST APIs, GraphQL, and WebSockets. This site is his personal portfolio.

Contact: arslansaleem622@gmail.com; GitHub: https://github.com/arslanmuhammad-dev; LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/muhammad-arslan-0624971b5
